Application Data.NAME: Grace Community Church
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Grace Community Church is dedicated to fostering spiritual growth and providing a welcoming environment for worship services, community outreach programs, youth activities, and various support services for families in need. We actively engage in organizing charitable events, counseling sessions, and educational workshops to serve the local community. Our facility also hosts meetings, social gatherings, and interfaith dialogues to promote unity and understanding among diverse groups.
